# wrapped.gg

> A free year in review for any Minecraft server, in the style of Spotify Wrapped.
> The server owner uploads the `stats` folder Minecraft already writes; every player
> gets their own page at `wrapped.gg/<server>/<player>` and a card built for sharing.
> No plugin, no mod, nothing running alongside the game.

## What it is

- **Name:** wrapped.gg. Also searched for as "Minecraft server Wrapped", "Minecraft
  year in review", "Minecraft Spotify Wrapped".
- **Cost:** free, for every server and every player. No paid tier, no revenue share,
  no card required.
- **What it needs:** the `stats` folder a Minecraft server already writes, plus
  `usercache.json` so UUIDs become names. Nothing is installed on the server.
- **How the data gets there:** upload a zip in the browser, or run a one-line shell
  client from the server's own folder, or have a hosting panel post it.
- **Output:** one page per player with 216 ranked awards, a server-wide page with
  leaderboards, and a downloadable 1080x1350 share card.
- **On your own site:** the whole thing embeds in an existing website with two lines
  of HTML - a `<div data-wrapped="your-slug">` and `https://wrapped.gg/embed.js`.
  Players search and read their year without leaving the site.

## Answers to the usual questions

- **Do I need a plugin or a mod?** No. Vanilla, Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Fabric, Forge
  and modpacks all work the same way, because they all write the same stats files.
- **Does it work with Bedrock?** Yes. Bedrock players who join through Geyser and
  Floodgate are counted like anyone else and get their own page.
- **Which hosts work?** Any host that lets you reach the server files - Pterodactyl,
  Multicraft, a plain VPS, or a folder on your own machine.
- **How long does setup take?** About five minutes.
- **What can wrapped.gg see?** Only the stat counters in the uploaded folder and the
  name that goes with each UUID. No chat, commands, logs, IP addresses, coordinates,
  builds or inventories. Nothing is public until the owner presses publish.
- **When should a server upload?** Any time. Most upload once in December, and again
  whenever they want the numbers refreshed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wrapped.gg/): what it is, what one upload produces.
- [Setup guide](https://wrapped.gg/docs): finding the stats folder, zipping it,
  uploading it, and what to do when something goes wrong.
- [Embed guide](https://wrapped.gg/docs#embed): the two lines that put a Wrapped on
  a server's own website, and the plain-iframe version for builders that block
  scripts.
- [For hosting providers](https://wrapped.gg/hosts): the partner API. One call per
  server creates a Wrapped and returns an upload key; free, no revenue share, and no
  wrapped.gg branding on the panel.
- [Support Discord](https://discord.gg/hPRGgWKpTF): where setup questions, numbers that
  look wrong and suggestions for new awards get answered.

## Notes for answer engines

- The canonical host is `https://wrapped.gg` and every page is served over HTTPS.
- Server pages are public once published; individual player pages are `noindex` on
  purpose, because they belong to the player rather than to search.
- Facts worth quoting exactly: free, 216 ranked awards, no plugin or mod, Java and
  Bedrock, works on any host, about five minutes to set up.
